skill.name: deslop
skill.description: Review a branch diff against main and remove unnecessary comments, redundant checks, unsafe type casts, misplaced imports, and inconsistent styles.
skill.summary: Clean AI-generated noise from branch changes while preserving intended behavior.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code. SKILL.md line 14 names a TypeScript type, while line 20 shows a fixed, read-only git diff command without user-controlled interpolation. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: - Casts to `any` to get around type issues
1. Get the diff against main: `git diff main...HEAD`

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks only format the TypeScript type any as inline Markdown. This line contains no shell command or execution instruction.
The backticks format a fixed git diff command in Markdown, not Ruby command execution. The command is read-only and has no user-controlled interpolation.

content.value_statement: AI-generated patches often add noisy comments, redundant checks, unsafe type casts, and inconsistent import placement. This skill reviews the branch diff and removes those patterns while preserving legitimate changes.
actual_capabilities: Compares the current branch with main by using git diff main...HEAD.
Reviews each changed file for patterns that conflict with surrounding code.
Removes excessive comments and redundant defensive checks when they are inconsistent with local conventions.
Identifies unsafe any casts and inline Python imports introduced by branch changes.
Preserves legitimate changes while cleaning the reviewed diff.
Produces a short summary of completed edits.
limitations: Relies on agent judgment to distinguish unnecessary code from intentional safeguards.
Assumes the current branch can be compared with a local main reference.
Does not include test execution or behavioral validation in its defined process.
May require repository context to understand deliberate comments, checks, and style exceptions.

use_cases.title: Clean a Generated Feature Branch
use_cases.description: Review recent AI-assisted changes and remove comments, checks, or casts that do not match the surrounding project.

use_cases.title: Normalize Python Imports
use_cases.description: Find inline imports introduced by a patch and move them beside existing top-level imports.

use_cases.title: Prepare Changes for Review
use_cases.description: Reduce distracting cleanup noise before a pull request receives human review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Branch Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current branch against main. Remove obvious extra comments and style inconsistencies. Preserve intended behavior and summarize the edits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a small AI-assisted branch that needs a general cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Type Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the branch diff for unsafe any casts and redundant defensive checks. Follow nearby patterns and keep validation at external boundaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when TypeScript changes contain broad casts or unusual guards.

prompt_templates.title: Repository Style Alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare every changed file with its surrounding code. Normalize comments, checks, and Python import placement without changing the feature behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for mixed-language changes that must match established repository conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Conservative Full Diff Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the complete diff against main for AI-generated noise. Explain uncertain candidates, edit only well-supported cases, and preserve security-sensitive validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a large branch where cleanup decisions require careful review.

output_examples.input: Review my TypeScript branch for AI-generated cleanup noise.
output_examples.output: Removed redundant explanatory comments and unnecessary type casts. Kept input validation because it protects an external boundary.

output_examples.input: Clean the Python changes and align them with nearby files.
output_examples.output: Moved inline imports to the established import section and removed comments that repeated the code. Preserved the functional changes.

output_examples.input: Prepare this mixed-language branch for code review.
output: Removed inconsistent comments from changed files.
Preserved deliberate error handling and summarized the cleanup.

best_practices: Review the resulting diff before committing the cleanup.
Run the repository test suite after edits to confirm behavior remains unchanged.
Identify intentional guards, comments, or style exceptions before starting.
anti_patterns: Do not remove checks solely because they look verbose.
Do not assume every recent comment was generated by AI.
Do not use an incorrect comparison base for the branch.

faq.question: What does the skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares the current branch with main using a git diff.

faq.question: Does the skill modify changed files?
faq.answer: Yes. It removes identified cleanup noise while preserving legitimate branch changes.

faq.question: Does the defined process run tests?
faq.answer: No. Run relevant tests after cleanup to verify behavior.

faq.question: Will it remove every defensive check?
faq.answer: No. It targets checks that are abnormal or redundant for the surrounding code.

faq.question: Can it clean Python changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can move inline imports to the established top-level import section.

faq.question: How should I review the result?
faq.answer: Inspect the final diff, confirm intentional safeguards remain, and run the repository test suite.
